changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, created_at) SELECT (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'SUPER_ADMIN'), p.id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM permissions p WHERE p.code IN ( 'ATTENDANCE:CREATE', 'ATTENDANCE:VIEW', 'ATTENDANCE:EDIT', 'REWARD:MANAGE', 'RANKING:VIEW', 'RANKING:EXPORT', 'SEASON:MANAGE', 'CONFIG:MANAGE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'SUPER_ADMIN') AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
